about: Parallel arcs: a->b spelled twice, and a four-layer spine a->b->c->d with a->d alongside a second a->c. The repeated a->b is the case the SciGraphs conformance job found -- the reference's `_acyclic_arcs` collects into a `set`, so two parallel edges are one arc, one dummy chain and one entry in up/down, while an edge-indexed port gives two of each and moves the layer index, the per-layer order and X. Without this fixture the dagre crossing gate is structurally blind to that: none of the other six fixtures, and no synthetic DAG the dump emits, has a parallel arc.
